ecommerce_revenue.text:
Description: In 2023, the revenue of the e-commerce sector in Italy hit nearly 80.6 billion euros, a significant increase from a year earlier, when it amounted to roughly 75.9 billion euros. According to the data, e-commerce revenue increased steadily and more than
fourfold throughout the period considered. When looking at the most popular categories, e-commerce users prefer to shop online for products and services related to leisure activities. Read more
Note(s): Italy
Source(s): Casaleggio Associati

Description: In 2023, e-commerce revenue went up by 27.14 percent in Italy. This represented a significant growth but still a slowdown compared to the growth registered in 2021 (33 percent). As the COVID-19 pandemic broke out in 2020, the year-over-year change
registered a negative trend for the first time in more than a decade. Read more
Note(s): Italy; 2009 to 2023
Source(s): Casaleggio Associati

Description: By the end of 2023, the value of e-commerce services purchases might reach 19.2 billion euros in Italy. This is a significant increase compared to just 9.3 billion euros registered in 2021. However it pales in comparison with product purchases. Their value
is forecast to reach 35 billion euros in 2023. Read more
Note(s): Italy; 2018 to 2023
Source(s): Osservatori Digital Innovation

forecast_users.text:
Description: The number of users in the e-commerce market in Italy was modeled to stand at 19.49 million users in 2024. Following a continuous upward trend, the number of users has risen by 10.12 million users since 2017. Between 2024 and 2029, the number of
users will rise by 5.69 million users, continuing its consistent upward trajectory. Read more
Note(s): Italy; 2017 to 2029
Source(s): Statista; Statista Market Insights
